newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle slow at $72 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle slow at $72 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area early Wednesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry.

Sales reported on 1,000 slaughter steers and 1,000 heifers; 61,400 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 12,900 formulated and 600 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.

Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 72.00. Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1200 lbs 71.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 72.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 70.50-71.00. Confirmed - 2,000
